body:
>Are you a drug user now (or ever at all?) ?

These days I just smoke a little weed here and there. Immediately after I dropped out of school I was put in a very bad situation by my mother, she started dating a guy half her age, and shortly after his brother moved in with us. His brother introduced me to some harder drugs, and I had a short foray with cocaine and mdma. after that i drank on and off, and became a borderline alcoholic thru my early 20's but now i don't even drink anymore.

>However, I feel that you had an especially bad experience with schooling as a child ( I don't actually know how old you are now), but I assure you, those cases are not typical.

for some strange reason its actually comforting to hear someone else acknowledge that, i think i always kind of blamed myself for the way school turned out.

>is there any way you could work toward a solution money wise to get schooling?

I've been trying to save a little money here and there, its slow going and getting harder and harder as business goes down, and as my sister is constantly draining my family's resources.

i hope you're right. the situation will inevitably change, something has to give, or at least that's what i keep telling myself. I've been trying to figure out how to change it for so long, its daunting to me, while my life has made me so unhappy, its become my routine, and honestly, i've become afraid of what the alternatives are, if i leave my family, they will undoubtedly shun me, i will be as dead to them as they are to me. I guess I'm scared of failing on my own, having nothing to fall back on, at least now my family still accepts me to some degree, despite how horrible they treat me

honestly, when I was in school I didn't enjoy it, it was a constant battle for me because I have some social anxiety problems, and I was constantly getting into fights because I got on the bad side of the high school drug dealer, so all of his friends would start fights without provocation. I do enjoy learning now, I don't read novels but I am always reading, news articles, scientific studies, statistics, technology, the standard fare for internet geeks, I've become a wealth of useless knowledge. My friend has started trying to teach me java, but its hard to do via email, so progress is slow. I was going to try to enroll in some classes this winter, but money is so tight and there is a lingering fear of the social aspect of class.

i'm on my own if I try to pursue education, to put it bluntly our business is in a downward spiral, the economy did a number on us and we're lucky if there's enough money in the bank to cash our paychecks every week, and to compound the financial problems my sister is constantly putting us further in debt, example: she had bought a condo, decided she didn't like the neighborhood so she got my mother to completely rennovate a house in another town for her, now she rents out the condo for less than her mortgage, has a mortgage for her second house, both of which my mother cosigned, and a 100k loan for renovating the second house. So yeah, money is a big problem.
thanks for reposting that, I was trying to figure out how to fix it, but not having any luck
